name: Site health check
description: Read-only health check of the sites and apps on the VPS: route, HTTP status, certificate, container health and errors. Changes nothing.
author: AmberX AXF

data.brief:
Check these sites, read-only: {{sites}}.
For each: does the route answer (curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}"), the HTTP status, the certificate expiry (warn under 14 days), the container behind it (docker ps / inspect: running, health, restarts) and the last errors in its log (docker logs --tail 200, errors only).
Do not restart, fix or change anything. Report one line per site: ok / warn / down, and why.
